additional_info.subject: Notes from RC/customer
additional_info.body: We are experiencing an issue with the cable management system. Despite following the instructions in the manual precisely, the rubber band keeps slipping. Additionally, during reassembly, we often encounter the problem that the nut and the brass thread do not hold for long and eventually slip through.
